tools.name: check_package
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether one specific package version has known vulnerabilities, which version fixes them, its license, or how outdated it is (for example lodash 4.17.15 on npm or django 3.2.0 on PyPI). Reads live OSV.dev and deps.dev records and returns Markdown, CSV and PDF reports. Nee
